title: Gold Leaf Mix Solo 2-Color #30 (부채꼴·매끈 | 로즈골드+에메랄드)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, loose beach waves mid-length tousled — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 2 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 2 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 54% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 2 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock and 6 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ROSE-GOLD metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright ROSE-GOLD sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied EMERALD GREEN metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright EMERALD GREEN sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every leaf sheet and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
